notes.title: 🎉 Official Release: The Game is Out of Early Access! 🚀
notes.notes:
🎉 Hey everyone! 🎉

Big news: the game is officially out of early access! 🥳 All the core mechanics are now locked in, and we’re thrilled to finally share this milestone with you.

A huge shoutout to everyone who gave us feedback during early access—you’ve helped us build a stronger, better game. 💪 We’ve taken your input, polished things up, and laid a solid foundation to keep growing from here.

But wait, there’s more! 🚀 We’re already cooking up ideas for more fun levels and content to keep you entertained. Right now, the game features 4 unique anomaly maps to explore:

🔹 Floor 4
🔹 Floor 5
🔹 Barny’s Party
🔹 Stairs

We can’t wait to bring you even more surprises soon. Thanks for sticking with us on this journey—we couldn’t have done it without your amazing support. 💙

Cheers,

The Developer 🕹️

notes.title: Changes coming this month
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're hard at work creating new content and cool new experiences and we'd like to share with you what we are working on.

New Maps
This month we will be releasing new maps!

These maps will be more in line with the quality and style of 'Floor 4', our first map.

According to the feedback we have received, you enjoyed Floor 4 a lot.
It has a good balance between proper actual anomalies, a good map size that is not too big nor too small, a good challenge and it has a slight fright/tension to it.

Overall Floor 4 sets the basis for what the direction of future maps will go in.

For those of you who do like the easier maps that are more scary/jumpscare focused, we have the Barny the Clown series that will continue to be available. 
We will move the entrance to its own dedicated location in the Lobby. 
This way we have a good distinction between more traditional 'Floor 4' styled maps, and scarier jumpscare focused maps.

The 'Stairs' map has not been enjoyed by a lot of people, so we're moving that to the dedicated 'shitty map' section somewhere in the Lobby. 


Summary

 New levels are in the works, and will be releasing this month.
 We are actively listening to your feedback and adding more of what you like.


Thanks guys,

The Developer

notes.title: Graphics update - Major visual overhaul
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The game has had a major graphic overhaul, giving it a brand new look!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010614/4c51b4780c0da9ba71ddc60156c00774c6312886.gif

Based on your great feedback we have decided to remove the VHS (blur) filter from the default setup of the game. For those of you who did enjoy the VHS backrooms inspired look, it is still available in the settings menu.

With this update the buzzing background sound is turned off by default.

The game looks absolutely epic now! Please go give it a look.

Update overview:

 VHS disabled by default
 Buzzing sound disabled by default
 Added VHS toggle option to settings menu
 Brand new graphics look
 Performance updates
 Loadingscreen now shows a variety of in-game locations as wallpapers


Also, the progress on Barny's Chapter 2 is going really well!

Oh, and checkout the new Barny's Party trailer on the Steam store page, we worked hard on it!

Greetings,

The Developer

notes.title: Barny's Party Chapter 1 | Map release
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

Barny's Party Chapter 1 is now live and ready for you to be enjoyed! Are you ready to meet the clown?

Ooohhahhaha... He lurks around the corner, who knows what he might do...

Oh, and his brother Munty the Clown might join the party too, so be on the lookout. 

Oh and by the way, in case it gets dark... Yeah well, then it might be smart to turn your headlamps on so that you can spot anomalies in our new lockdown dark mode events.

Also introduced in this level is more interactivity with the environment, sounds and plenty of rather dark anomalies.

More features:

Play with the claw machine
Checkout Barny's miniature friend
Need to go to the toilet? Visit the restroom
Go for a swim in the poolrooms
Crawl through the kids playhouses
And more


So what are you waiting for? Too scared to go in?

Gather your friends and have fun at Barny's Party. What could go wrong...

Greetings,

The developer

notes.title: Barny's Party (New map) | Progress update
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Lead developer here with a little update on the Barny's Party map.

We're making great progress and are nearing the release of Barny's Party. For me personally this is our most anticipated map yet. We've put in loads of effort already to make it a fun, tense and scary. 

The focus of this map is on the constant tension that we aim to introduce here. This map needs to be one of our horror themed maps. It needs to make you suspicious and cautious of your environment all the time. I'm sure that Barny himself will help you guys with that a lot too : ).

The map is rather large and includes loads of cool sections such as a miniature kids playhouse area, a kids mini swimming pool area, Barny's playground, a river ride with boats, a scary maze and more.

Can't wait to have it finished and to release it to you guys! Thanks for all the support!

After this map releases we aim to introduce our brand new game-mode which I'll tell you more about then.

If all goes according to plan this map will release before end of the month! With this update we also release our item shop located in the lobby, with fun outfits/cosmetics and character customization.

Cheers,

The developer

notes.title: Short status update - New maps
notes.notes:
Hi Anomaly Hunters,

Quick update here: We've been working very hard on the new Barny's Party map which is nearly finished. However we have decided to allocate more time for the map, we're thinking about 2 extra weeks to add more touches that we think will make the map an insanely cool new map.

In the mean time we've set up a very fun and challenging map called 'Stairs' which we are releasing tomorrow, the 8th of August.

Thanks for the support so far and we're looking forward to seeing you guys in the new map.

This was the short update.

Over and out
